title: Campbell's Cooking Sauces, Hearty Beef Stew, 12 Oz Pouch

reviews.title: Great enhancer to any beef cut in the slow cooker.
reviews.body: We love this Campbell's Beef Stew Sauce for making beef in the slow cooker. Whether it's a roast, beef cutlets, or any cut in between, this is the perfect sauce to enhance slow cooked beef. It also make a nice gravy for mashed potatoes as it cooks.While we haven't made beef stew, we do cook chunked up potatoes at the same time with a roast. This adds flavor to the potatoes, too. Good stuff.

reviews.title: Delicious and Easy
reviews.body: This is great for a quick and easy dinner. Everyone loved the flavor, and I loved the ease of chopping up potatoes, carrots and onions, and throwing it all in a crockpot with a roast. I didn’t have to season it because this did the trick!

features: One 12 oz pouch of Campbell's Hearty Beef Stew Cooking Sauce
Just add beef, potatoes and vegetables and bake in the oven for a hearty homemade family meal
Versatile cooking sauce can also be used to make stovetop meals, slow cooker meals and multi cooker meals
Made with tomato puree, beef stock, red wine, and a unique beef stew seasoning mix – no need to measure spices
A convenient shortcut to homemade; adds instant flavor to beef, starches and vegetables
